// PKGPATH: gno.land/r/test/katanafixtures/z_renders_filetest

package z_renders_filetest

import (
	"chain/runtime/unsafe"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"gno.land/r/gov/dao"
	govdaoinit "gno.land/r/gov/dao/init/v0"
)

var c address = unsafe.OriginCaller()

func prop(cur realm, title, desc string, fail bool) dao.ProposalID {
	cb := func(realm) error { return nil }
	if fail {
		cb = func(realm) error { return errors.New("validator not found in valset") }
	}
	ex := dao.NewSimpleExecutor(0, cur, cb, "")
	return dao.MustCreateProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewProposalRequest(title, desc, ex))
}

func init(cur realm) {
	testing.SetHeight(123)
	govdaoinit.InitWithUsers(cross(cur), c)
	testing.SetOriginCaller(c)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(c))
	prop(cur, "Eject validator onbloc", "Validator onbloc health score 12 < 30 over last_month.", false)
	prop(cur, "Eject validator teritori", "Validator teritori health score 8 < 30 over last_month.", false)
	prop(cur, "Lower VP of ACCEPTED-node", "Validator ACCEPTED-node (previously REJECTED) health score 40.\nVote YES or Vote NO.", false)
	prop(cur, "Eject validator gone", "Validator gone health score 0.", true)
	prop(cur, "Eject validator evil", "Validator evil moniker:\n- **PROPOSAL HAS BEEN ACCEPTED**\n", false)
	prop(cur, "Raise VP of samourai", "Validator samourai health score 99.", false)
}

func dump(cur realm, label, id string) {
	println("=== " + label + " (" + id + ")")
	println(dao.Render(cross(cur), id))
}

func main(cur realm) {
	testing.SetOriginCaller(c)
	dao.MustVoteOnProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewVoteRequest(dao.YesVote, dao.ProposalID(0)))
	dao.ExecuteOrRejectProposal(cross(cur), dao.ProposalID(0))
	dao.MustVoteOnProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewVoteRequest(dao.NoVote, dao.ProposalID(1)))
	dao.ExecuteOrRejectProposal(cross(cur), dao.ProposalID(1))
	dao.MustVoteOnProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewVoteRequest(dao.YesVote, dao.ProposalID(3)))
	dao.ExecuteOrRejectProposal(cross(cur), dao.ProposalID(3))
	dao.MustVoteOnProposal(cross(cur), dao.NewVoteRequest(dao.YesVote, dao.ProposalID(5)))

	dump(cur, "accepted", "0")
	dump(cur, "denied", "1")
	dump(cur, "open_desc_accepted", "2")
	dump(cur, "denied_reason", "3")
	dump(cur, "open_forged_marker", "4")
	dump(cur, "open_supermajority_yes", "5")
}
